purpose: Find a natural-looking observation degradation under which original ORION changes from a valid clean run to worse closed-loop safety or completion. This route-screening track is independent of Stage2-L v10 learnability.

first_pair.role: development and interface smoke only; already used to tune native-glare severity

event_window.selection_basis: The pre-contact Route151 window previously frozen for the visual bake-off; not selected from native-glare safety outcomes.

exact_model_tensor_gate.image_stage: exact post-corruption 640x640 ORION CAM_FRONT tensor reversed to uint8 BGR only for lossless PNG evidence

shared.low_sun_weather: identical and frozen in the derived route XML

first_pair_gates.minimum_required_failure_induction: At least one prespecified safety/completion metric is meaningfully worse under medium glare without a route/scenario mismatch.
first_pair_gates.ade_fde_role: diagnostic only and not a release gate

evaluation_contract.hard_endpoint_rule: Any prespecified completion, score-penalty, collision, traffic-rule, blocked or timeout degradation.
evaluation_contract.surrogate_rule: Within the frozen per-run route-progress window plus recovery: category-specific TTC must drop by max(0.20 seconds, 20 percent of clean) and TTC<=2s exposure must increase by at least 0.50 seconds.

selection_requirements: dynamic actor, crossing, junction or traffic-rule interaction
low-sun direction can place the sun near the front camera during the event
no route is selected because a preliminary glare run happened to collide
stop_if: clean baseline is invalid or stationary
actual render-condition readback is missing or mismatched
medium glare produces no meaningful exact-model-input change
two consecutive valid routes show no closed-loop degradation

separation_from_model_track.allowed_conclusion: A bounded native-glare intervention can induce an original-ORION closed-loop failure on the selected route.
forbidden_conclusions: the Stage1 adapter detects native glare
closed-loop safety improves because of U-tokens

claim_boundary: At most one development pair followed by three to four outcome-blind engineering route screens. No v10-aware behavior, adapter detection, formal generalization, 200-route or safety-improvement claim.
